description: This module allows you to create and delete devices in CA Spectrum https://www.ca.com/us/products/ca-spectrum.html.

parameters.name: agentport
parameters.description: UDP port used for SNMP discovery. Default: 161

parameters.name: community
parameters.description: SNMP community used for device discovery. Required when state=present.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: IP address of the device. If a hostname is given, it is resolved to the IP address.

parameters.name: landscape
parameters.description: Landscape handle of the SpectroServer to which add or remove the device.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: On present creates the device when it does not exist. On absent removes the device when it exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: HTTP, HTTPS URL of the Oneclick server in the form (http|https)://host.domain[:port].

parameters.name: use_proxy
parameters.description: If false, it does not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Add device to CA Spectrum
  local_action:
    module: spectrum_device
    device: '{{ ansible_host }}'
    community: secret
    landscape: '0x100000'
    oneclick_url: http://oneclick.example.com:8080
    oneclick_user: username
    oneclick_password: password
    state: present


- name: Remove device from CA Spectrum
  local_action:
    module: spectrum_device
    device: '{{ ansible_host }}'
    landscape: '{{ landscape_handle }}'
    oneclick_url: http://oneclick.example.com:8080
    oneclick_user: username
    oneclick_password: password
    use_proxy: false
    state: absent

return_values.name: device
return_values.description: Device data when state=present. Returned: success Sample: {"address": "10.10.5.1", "landscape": "0x100000", "model_handle": "0x1007ab"}
